input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date
input.rationale: Article IV commits us to a 36-month Initial Period and contains no right for Licensee to terminate for convenience; nor does any other termination provision (Article XIX insolvency, Article XX change of control/wind-up, Article XXI effect of termination) or the General Provisions give us a no-cause exit. Termination rights run one way: Licensor may terminate immediately on any Licensee breach, on a Change of Control and on wind-up. Absence of any Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months falls into walk-away territory and fails the fallback (which would allow 60-90 days' notice with a fee capped at 3 months' fees). Proposed the preferred position: Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, inserted into Article IV; Licensor has no convenience right, so no deletion is needed.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month Initial Period gives us no exit right at all, while Licensor may terminate immediately on breach, change of control or wind-up, so we have added a convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees, per our playbook position. If you need more runway we can move to 60 days' notice.

ops.text: IV Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early termination charge or other liability, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of such termination.
